scores.tell: Binocular card has a detailed city skyline, glass railing with posts and tiled terrace; too many small elements and a busy, deep environment, with a face-like hero.

Pier scene is a full environment with sea, sand, ropes, a life ring and distant posts. It is fairly busy and has rippling water detail. It stays central and its shapes are large, but it is above the swing card in load.
none. Flat purple stripes, hero floats, category 1 like the real cards.
Soccer ball fills the card with a pitch of many small grass blades, a line and shadowed grass. Grass detail is busy and noisy next to the quiet real backdrops.
Pi-pattern backdrop is tone-on-tone and quiet, like the whistle card. Maybe slightly large motifs.
Plain lavender wall with a ledge, like the real ledge cards. The red-striped base is a small invented prop, though a purposeful one.
Wavy tone-on-tone purple pattern is quiet. The pattern is a little larger and more contrasty than real ones, but fine.
none. Concentric rings backdrop is identical to the real boot-type cards.
Concentric orange rings, quiet and tone-on-tone, with no props.
Golf scene has hills, clouds and many grass blades with a ball and club. The environment is busier than real cards, with small grassy detail in the foreground.
